title: Post Effects (Library of Ruina)
description: Turns bloom back on in the Switch version. Host callbacks force the bloom of the game's v1 camera stack (UnityEngine.PostProcessing, OnPreCull) and of the v2 stack (UnityEngine.Rendering.PostProcessing, Bloom.IsEnabledAndSupported) on when they are off, force the Story Filter option (OptionDataModel.GetStoryFilterOn, which gates every CamFilterController.SetFilter effect) on, and log which of the game's bloom sources (v1, v2, RFX4_Bloom, RFX4_DistortionAndBloom, CameraFilterPack_Blur_Bloom) run and with what settings.

launcher.label: Post Effects (Bloom)
launcher.note: Brings back the bloom the Switch version leaves out. May cost some fps.
